statement: You receive a non-negative integer n and a bit position i, counted from 0 at the least significant end. Decide whether bit i of n is set. Build the mask 1 shifted left by i, AND it with n, and compare with zero. Print 1 if the bit is set and 0 if it is clear.

example.why: 13 is 1101 in binary; position 2 holds a one, positions 1 and 4 hold zeros.

hint: The AND result is either zero or the mask itself - test against zero, nothing else.
mistake: Comparing the AND result with 1; for every position above zero the set case equals the mask, so the test always fails.
